truth_boundary: Successful CI proves dependency compatibility, static type correctness, domain and in-memory persistence behavior, and platform-targeted Expo bundle generation. It does not prove native binary compilation, installation, launch, touch interaction, visual correctness, AsyncStorage restoration after reopening on a physical phone, or production readiness.
